list.name: Changes
list.comment: Again, I was lying about highlighting and vision. But first, I made enemy subclasses! (check the zombie class). Funny thing is, I refactored tile_info to tile_itself (cuz I like it when it goes player.tile_itself). Then it made highlighting go absolutely haywire. After struggling for a few hrs, I realized that in the Zombie class, tile_info was not changed to tile_itself, which is weird honestly. Back to highlighting and vision, I optimized rendering to my fullest ability, having to add many edge cases after. This did not really help the lag that much, and the biggest optimization I can make will probably be in the determine light levels. I will have to pre-compute every ray (meaning that I'll add another for loop inside the_pattern_forge yay!!!!!!!). I'll report on that when it's done.
